data.arguments: {"role": "Explorer", "task": "list the top-level files of the current working directory"}

content.text:
role Explorer (complete)
summary: The working directory /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-XcXkIq/ws-roles contains NO top-level regular files. Its only top-level entries are two hidden directories: .mpd/ and .codegraph/. Everything present is runtime state (logs, watchdog heartbeats, a verify boot record, a codegraph index); there is no source file of any language at the root or anywhere in the tree.
recommendation: Read this as "no answer to enumerate": there is nothing at the workspace root to list. If the caller expected a project (source, AGENTS.md, mpd.jsonc, README), they are pointed at the wrong directory or the workspace has not been populated yet. Start by verifying the cwd the delegating agent used; if the intent was to inspect harness state, start at /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-XcXkIq/ws-roles/.mpd/verify/boot.json (the only non-log data file) and /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-XcXkIq/ws-roles/.mpd/logs/ (15 log files).
details: FINDINGS (what I actually globbed in /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-XcXkIq/ws-roles):

1) Top-level regular files: NONE.
   - Anchored patterns `*/*` (=> only .codegraph/*) and `.mpd/*` (=> no files) plus `**/*` (complete tree, 20 files) together show no path with a single path segment, i.e. no file directly under the root.
   - Absent at the root: AGENTS.md, README*, mpd.jsonc, package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, any *.ts/*.js/*.py/*.go/*.rs source, and any dotfile (`.mpd` and `.codegraph` are directories, not files).

2) Top-level entries are exactly two directories (both hidden; inferred from descendant paths, since glob lists files only):
   - .mpd/   — harness state. Its own top level holds only subdirectories: logs/ (15 *.log files, e.g. mpd-roles.log, mpd-roster.log, mpd-config.log, mpd-verify.log, mpd-team-core.log, mpd-team-watchdog.log, mpd-bootstrap.log, mpd-dsh-adapter.log, mpd-goal.log, mpd-codegraph.log, mpd-patch-guards.log, mpd-mcp-lsp.log, mpd-ext.log, mpd-tui.log, mpd-verify.log), verify/ (boot.json — the only *.json in the whole tree), team/watchdog/heartbeat/ (session-session.jsonl, session-03d33415.jsonl). `.mpd/*` (direct children) matched zero files, so .mpd has no files of its own at depth 1.
   - .codegraph/ — index. Contains .gitignore, codegraph.db (SQLite knowledge-graph index; implies the workspace is codegraph-indexed, `.codegraph/` present so codegraph_explore is available here), init.cooldown.

3) Content survey confirming emptiness of code: `**/*.{ts,tsx,js,py,go,rs,md,json,jsonc}` returns exactly one path, .mpd/verify/boot.json. No markdown, no manifest, no source.

EVIDENCE TOOLS / GAP: only the glob tool (file-level) was usable for this; it cannot see directories or empty directories. A shell-equivalent `ls -la` of the root would be the exact confirmation but is outside my read-only tool grant — the gap is limited to directory-vs-file labeling and to any empty directory that contains no file at all (such a directory would be invisible to every glob I ran). Nothing was modified.
evidence:
- glob '/'/' pattern '**/*' (workspace-relative, cwd /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-XcXkIq/ws-roles) => 20 paths, all under .mpd/ or .codegraph/; no root-level file
- glob pattern '.mpd/*' (direct children of .mpd, anchored depth) => 'No files found' — .mpd has zero files at depth 1, only subdirectories
- glob pattern '.*/*' => only .codegraph/.gitignore, .codegraph/codegraph.db, .codegraph/init.cooldown — the other top-level dir is .codegraph
- glob pattern '**/*.{ts,tsx,js,py,go,rs,md,json,jsonc}' => only .mpd/verify/boot.json (boot record); no source or docs anywhere in the tree
- glob absolute-path pattern '/tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-XcXkIq/ws-roles/*' => 'No files found' (absolute patterns are not resolved; relative/anchored globs above are the reliable ones)
